generation: P5 Disc 'P5D' (2019-2023; EX11 riser at launch, EX10 riser on later bikes)
identify: Disc-brake P5 in five sizes (48-58), 28 mm tyre limit, integrated front end with a mono-riser post. Early bikes have the EX11 riser (no tilt); later bikes (about 2021 on) and converted bikes have the EX10 riser with a tilt plate. The 2024+ P5 has six sizes (adds 61), 34 mm tyres, the EX14 riser with 0-30 deg tilt and a basebar 10 mm lower.

cockpit.steerer: Proprietary fork/basebar interface; no standard stem.
cockpit.stem: None: basebar bolts to the fork; pad stack comes from a mono-riser post (EX11 or EX10) clamped in the front end.
cockpit.stack_system: Mono-riser post height (EX11 or EX10) plus basebar stack hardware. Fitter limits quoted on Slowtwitch for EX11-era bikes: max pad stack about 665 mm (54), 685 mm (56), about 700 mm (58).
cockpit.reach_system: Pad mount positions on the riser rest. EX11: limited reach range. EX10: forward and rear offset pad positions; fitter estimate about +12 mm more reach (or 20 mm more negative reach) than EX11.
cockpit.angle_system: EX11: none (0 deg). EX10: tilt plate with 5/10/15 deg settings. Above 15 deg needs an aftermarket adapter (AeroCoach, FastTT, TriRig plates on EX10).
cockpit.notes: Know which riser your bike has before buying: most aftermarket plates fit the EX10 (and EX14) only. A Cervélo-thread fitter (2021) said the published P5D fit charts do not show the extra EX10 range, so charts understate it. Fitter (2021): P5D pad ranges are narrower and longer than the old rim P5; riders with short pad reach fall off the chart. The 2019 retailer manual (search snippet) lists EX11 monoriser, EX11 riser post rests/pads and an HB11 basebar assembly.

parts.model: EX10 mono-riser with extension/pad mount and tilt adjustment plate (EX11 to EX10 conversion)

effect.text: Fitter estimate versus EX11: about 12 mm more forward reach or 20 mm more rearward, about 7 mm less minimum stack, almost 30 mm more maximum stack, and native tilt of 5/10/15 deg.

evidence.says: Search result: Cervélo EX10 Extension and Pad Mount (HBP-EX10-PADMNT) listed as compatible with P3X, PX-Series and P5 Disc, other items required per Cervélo's chart.
Search result: EX10 tilt adjustment plate (HBP-EX10-ADJPL) listed for P3X, PX-Series and P5 Disc.
Fit-thread fitter (May 2021): EX10 adds about 12 mm reach or 20 mm negative reach, loses ~7 mm low stack, gains almost 30 mm high stack; another poster notes the P5 now ships with EX10.
Fitter (Jan 2021): the EX11 that shipped with the P5D had more limited reach and zero tilt than the EX10.
Owners (2023) converting EX11 to EX10 for more extension shapes and angle options; kit often sold out, dealers could order it.
